title: Getting Started
description: Learn how to create full-stack web applications with the Next.js App Router.

Welcome to the getting started guide. It walks you through the core concepts of the App Router, from installing Next.js to deploying your first application.

## Before you begin

You should be comfortable with HTML, CSS, and React. If you're new to React, start with the React Foundations course.

## Next steps

Start with [Installation](/docs/app/getting-started/installation), then learn about [Layouts and Pages](/docs/app/getting-started/layouts-and-pages).
